general_information.name: OH—RIGHT, MY NAME IS ROBERT MILLER.

current_concerns.primary_problems: Mostly it’s been this sort of blah feeling, and I just don’t really enjoy things the way I used to. I’m tired a lot, and I’ve been pulling back from people. Sleep has gotten worse too—falling asleep is a bit of a fight.
current_concerns.goals: I’d like to enjoy life again, really, and stay active if I can.

medications.current_medications:
Medication 1: Name Or Description: Carbidopa-levodopa.; Dose: It’s 25/100 mg, one tablet three times daily.; Start Or Duration: Started in 2024.; Side Effects: Occasional nausea.
Medication 2: Name Or Description: Yes — latanoprost eye drops.; Dose: One drop in each eye nightly.; Start Or Duration: Started in 2021.; Side Effects: None known.
Medication 3: Name Or Description: Yes — allopurinol.; Dose: 100 mg daily.; Start Or Duration: Started in 2019.; Side Effects: None known.

medical_history.medical_conditions: Well, there’s Parkinson’s disease, and… I know there are a few other things, but I’m having to think them through. I believe one was glaucoma, and gout too. Also prostate cancer, though that’s in remission now. And a sleep thing—REM sleep behaviour disorder, I think.

family_psychiatric_history.family_psychiatric_history_details: Family member 1: Name Or Description: My granddaughter.; Diagnosis Or Condition: ADHD.; Additional Details: Diagnosed when she was 9.

substance_use.alcohol_use: Status: Current; Substance or product: Wine.; Quantity or frequency: Monthly.; Duration: Minimal.

education_employment_legal_history.highest_education: I have a bachelor’s degree. I was a teacher.
education_employment_legal_history.employment_history: Job 1: Name Or Description: Oakville District School Board.; Job Title: High school science teacher.; Dates: 1978 to 2013.

personal_history.early_childhood: Born and grew up, just... that part was pretty ordinary. I don’t have much else to say about it.
personal_history.adolescence_early_adulthood: School, mostly—then I became a teacher. That’s the main thing I remember from that time.
personal_history.significant_relationships: I’m married, and it’s been a long time—49 years now—with a supportive wife.
personal_history.future_goals: I’d like to enjoy life and manage the illness… and stay active, if possible.
